user.title: Connect an eParkai solar plant
user.description: Enter the client ID from /user/ID/generation and the plant option value. Object address is optional: try leaving it blank. If needed, copy the exact value from the portal address dropdown, not a typed street address. Add another entry for each plant/object.

data.name: Plant name
data.object_address: Object selection value (optional; not a typed street address)

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to eParkai
reauth_confirm.description: Check your credentials. If the portal asks to confirm contact details, complete that in your browser first.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check credentials and any portal contact-confirmation prompt.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to eParkai. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: Could not read generation data: {reason}. This can be a portal response-format issue. If you typed a street address, clear it and try again; when needed use the exact portal dropdown value.

abort.already_configured: This plant and object are already configured.

init.title: Connect to Energy dashboard
init.description: Imports historical hours and adds the selected source to Energy. Choose remote production + separate export only when all plant output is exported. Existing household meters are preserved. This adds sources; remove unwanted sources in Energy settings. Delayed reporting alone does not mean grid export.

error.import_not_ready: Hourly import is not ready. Check the import status sensor and HA logs, then retry.
error.energy_failed: Could not connect energy statistics. Check HA logs.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Resolve its setup error or restart HA first.
